rules.statement: A sale by a curator of the estate of minors, with leave of court and subsequent approval of accounts, cannot be impeached in a later action by an administrator unless there is fraud.
rules.supporting_quote: "The only ground on which it is competent for any other executor or any person interested in the estate to question in a new suit the proceedings in a former action which has resulted in a judgment against the property of the testator, is fraud."
